author: Coco_stag
body:
Basically, This would help people who try entering the boundaries on some maps. Like you can glitch abuse getting past a certain region. Yes, The blocks disappear but they can still make it to their destination; they can get past the region even though the blocks are disappearing.

So if anyone does this an automatic system either kills you or kicks you or AUTOMATICALLY deletes the block so you can't make it to the destination.

If you need me to elaborate further I can :D
